neuropathy_grade.label: Peripheral neuropathy (clinician-assessed CTCAE grade)
neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess sensory and motor symptoms, objective signs, gait and effects on instrumental versus self-care activities. NCCP00554 v3 Table3 uses peripheral neuropathy grade>2; it does not name the grading edition. CTCAE5.0 is the UI grading aid and is not asserted to be the source edition.

mucositis_grade.label: Mucositis (clinician-assessed CTCAE grade)
mucositis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess oral pain, ulceration, dietary modification and ability to eat/drink. NCCP00554 v3 Table3 separately gives grade1 and grade2 methotrexate changes; it does not identify the grading edition. CTCAE5.0 is a UI grading aid, not an assertion of source-edition equivalence; confirm clinician grading before applying the source pathway.

source.source_grading_edition: not specified in retrieved current text
